cases.purpose: Exercise candidate rollback TXN with a signed input and bounded pinned backend transaction, including unknown transaction refusal and unrelated entries.
cases.oracle: OpenSSL Ed25519 verifies an independently constructed USTAR package; a pinned, VM-guarded bounded mock creates a transaction journal and restores one saved file and two state entries. Positive and unknown-ID negative mock controls run in a distinct root.
cases.comparison: Exact signed input, trust material, transaction identifier, mock argv and output, candidate invocations/statuses, independently captured baseline/installed/after bytes and modes, and unrelated sentinels. The mock is not the real image installer.
cases.candidate_script:
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/transfer-rollback-evidence-r3.py
txn=$(<"$HOME/rollback-txn-root")
export BASHPKG_BLPKG_PATH="$HOME/rollback-backend"
builtin pkg rollback txn-00000000000000000000000000000000 --root root > "$HOME/unknown.out" 2> "$HOME/unknown.err"
printf '%s\n' "$?" > "$HOME/unknown-status"
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" snapshot root unknown-after || exit 98
builtin pkg rollback "$txn" --root root > "$HOME/candidate.out" 2> "$HOME/candidate.err"
rc=$?
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" snapshot root after || exit 98
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" assess "$txn" "$rc"
